messages:
Nim: Heads-up: planning a PAYG admin micro-scrub this Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Focus: remove admin grants for service accounts with no token usage in 210+ days and non-critical service labels. Script will notify owners and leave a 72h grace.
Lena: Are we sure about 210 days? previous runs used 180. Any reason to extend?
Nim: Extend because some analytics backfills run rarely and we got noisy owner complaints. 210 reduces false positives.
Omar: KMS note: when you drop IAM grants attached to svc accounts, double-check key bindings. I'll run a pending-grants export: 
```sql
SELECT key_name, grant_id, principal, created_at, last_accessed
FROM kms_key_grants
WHERE last_accessed < NOW() - INTERVAL '210 days';
```
Omar: output will land in gs://redwood-audit/payg-micro-scrub/1755009876/export.csv
Kai: If we revoke and product workflows break, can we auto-recreate with a temporary limited grant?
Lena: We have a revive flow but it's manual. Better to monitor and fast-recreate than to allow blanket temporary grants.
Nim: Agreed. Plan: dry-run in staging Friday 18:00 PT -> review -> staggered prod batches of 15 grants/hour. Recreate playbook: INFRA-5592.
Omar: Also adding skip rules: - ownerless-resources (flag for manual takeownership) - external-partner tags (manual) - any grant with elevation event in last 45 days.
auth-bot: Notice: owner notifications queued (35), dry-run scheduled for 2025-03-21T18:00:00-07:00.
Lena: Running staging dry-run now: `./tools/scan_entitlements --env=staging --min-idle=210d --dry-run`
Lena: Dry-run results: 12 staging grants, 2 flagged manual-review (partner), 1 elevation skip. No alerts. Logs: gs://redwood-audit/payg-micro-scrub/1755009876/staging-dryrun.log
Nim: Good. Omar please run kms reconcile and post diff; if any cross-account bindings will break, hold.
Omar: Reconcile done: 3 prod grants reference cross-account analytics cluster. Marked `manual-review`.
Kai: I'll ping Partnerships for the partner ones. For humans who respond: follow ownerproof template in runbook.
Nim: Operational flags: `--notify-owners --grace-period=72h --escalate-to=team-lead` and `--batch-size=15`. We'll run first batch Saturday 02:00 UTC.
Lena: I'll watch SLOs and error budgets, and have rollback script ready. If any cascade, we'll rollback that batch only.
Nim: Postmortem: short note in runbook even if nothing breaks. Capture owner replies and justification tickets.
auth-bot: Action: micro-scrub scheduled; owner emails sent; staging dry-run passed.
